summary: User P1/P2 testing completed. Backend APIs verified working (100% pass rate via curl). Frontend login, dashboard, scanner, settings, and activity-log pages all load correctly. Domain-based sidebar menu structure verified. Legacy route redirects working for exchange-settings and risk-policy to settings. Scanner page has section toggle for Scan Results and Indicator Screener.

minor.issue: Minimum limit is 10, returns 422 if limit < 10
Backend times out during pytest runs due to heavy background tasks. Curl tests work fine.

integration_issues.issue: Scanner page shows loading skeleton bars for extended time on preview URL due to network latency. Backend APIs return 200 OK locally.

critical_code_review_comments: PanelLayout.jsx: User sidebar shows domain-based grouped menu sections (DASHBOARD, MARKET, EXECUTION, PORTFOLIO, STRATEGY, MONITORING)
App.js: Legacy route redirects configured correctly - indicator-screener -> scanner?section=screener, exchange-settings -> settings, risk-policy -> settings
UserScannerPage.jsx: Section toggle implemented with scannerSection state and URL param 'section'. Toggle buttons for 'Scan Results' and 'Indicator Screener'
UserIndicatorScreenerPage.jsx: Embedded inside UserScannerPage when section=screener
UserSettingsPage.jsx: Unified settings page with Profile, Exchange Connections, and Risk Settings sections
UserActivityLogPage.jsx: Shows audit rows with action, entity_type, severity, details
context_for_next_testing_agent: User P1/P2 features verified: domain-based sidebar menu, scanner with section toggle, unified settings page, activity log. Backend APIs require device_id cookie + Bearer token for authentication. Preview URL has network latency issues but backend works locally.
